test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, REMAIN is coded as 92214261813. How will MACHINE be coded in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**All alphabet opposite place values are coded as numbers.**

'REMAIN' is coded as 92214261813

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2d3fa698fbe309719813713d9909d1705eecda8f239a845a5cff021d29a1614.png] 

Similarly, 

'MACHINE' = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb410f25af4b5f66e8a03cc057ef637d9d69a24bceaa002958f37995aaa18b62.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**14262419181322**".
